title: Quantile and quality-aware error budgeting with cross-variant credit transfer
creator: Priya Shah
description: Define and implement a per-endpoint SLI/SLO framework that combines latency quantiles and model-quality signals, implement an error-budget crediting mechanism that allows controlled cross-variant borrowing and repayment, and codify automated circuit-breaker and load-shedding rules that use combined quality+latency burn-rate. This work harmonizes per-model accuracy/regression SLIs (promptset-driven) with traditional availability/latency SLIs to make degradation decisions that avoid silent quality regressions while preserving user-facing latency SLOs.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical SLI definitions published for: latency (P50/P95/P99), tail latency (P99.9), request success (5xx + model-runtime errors), and quality SLI (promptset pass-rate) for each model variant.

Error-budget ledger implemented in policy-service with the ability to: allocate per-variant budgets, transfer credits between variants for up to 24h windows, and auto-reclaim borrowed credits when budgets recover.
Circuit-breaker rules updated to consider combined SLO burn-rate computed from weighted latency and quality signals (configurable weights per endpoint).
Load-shedding policy automation that: preemptively degrades low-priority routes to quantized variants or enforces soft-queue limits when composite burn-rate > 3x baseline.
Dashboards (Grafana) and alerting (PagerDuty) for: composite burn-rate, cross-variant borrow state, and simulated failover scenarios.
Runbook updated with step-by-step remediation and a scheduled oncall DR drill that simulates cross-region capacity loss with credit-transfer enabled.
End-to-end tests and a failure-mode simulation harness included in the PR with synthetic traffic showing expected eviction/borrow behaviors.
steps: Finalize SLI formulas and weightings with PM and Research (latency vs quality trade-offs)
Add promptset harness to quality SLI pipeline and build daily pass-rate metric per variant
Extend policy-service API: create endpoints for ledger operations (allocate, borrow, repay, reclaim)
Implement conservative default credit-transfer policy (max borrow = 20% of lender budget, TTL 24h)
Wire composite burn-rate into circuit-breaker decision path and ensure telemetry emits reasons for evictions
Author dashboards and alert thresholds; coordinate with oncall to tune noise vs signal
Run simulated failover + borrow scenarios; iterate on thresholds and rollback plan
Ship feature flags and gradual rollout to internal canary orgs before global enablement
